reuse.why: The rule change is made inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount helper and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance; no caller re-implements it.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the helper body actually gets simpler (Math.min and amount - threshold).

placement.why: The worst-case rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where every server and client consumer already reads it.

scope.why: Focused on the helper and its tests, but carries unrelated import reordering in api-models.ts/schedules.ts/the test and a reformatted call in schedules/app.ts, and leaves the stale 'furthest from zero' comment in app.ts syncing code.

maintainability.why: A two-line change in one shared definition with updated tests is easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers (forecast, posting, preview, budget template, API, UI) keep calling getScheduledAmount.
